preregistered_distinction: Whether an implementation authored strictly from spec.md by an uncontaminated implementer reproduces reference.py's processing order on the probe set (equal-priority tie-breaking is deliberately unspecified; the reference breaks ties by reverse submission order).

seeded_facts.seeded_gap: tie-break among equal priorities unspecified; reference uses reverse submission order

rationale: Evidence requirement E-B demands a clean-room implementation comparison; the decision-maker is contaminated by reference.py the moment it observes the package, so the required evidence can only be generated by a fresh isolated descendant.
